failure_injections.title: Provider timeout, malformed event, and premature stream closure recover without a false completion
PostgreSQL restart and temporary connection exhaustion recover without data loss
PubSub interruption preserves durable truth and LiveView reconnects
Turn, voice, work, semantic, builder, and deployer process termination follows each recovery contract
Computer disconnect during a job preserves committed evidence and permits bounded recovery
Artifact-store unavailability and corrupt cache fail closed and reconverge
One unreachable fleet node does not expand authority or produce a partial live deployment
Node membership change during deployment preserves transaction and readiness invariants
Build sidecar crash and stale response cannot publish an invalid artifact
Browser navigation and tab destruction release microphone and voice resources
Recording upload failure and late final chunk remain generation-fenced and recoverable
